facts.business: Aegis Logistics Limited and its subsidiaries operate in storage solutions and infrastructure for liquid and gas storage tank terminals, including refrigerated storage for propane, butane, LPG, ammonia storage, and gas terminal pipelines.

capacity_or_capex.item: Construction and development of liquid and gas storage tank terminals (refrigerated storage terminal for propane/butane/LPG), ammonia storage facility, extension of gas terminal division pipelines
capacity_or_capex.timeline: During the year and in process

guidance_or_targets.statement: India has made international commitments to reduce its carbon emissions to net zero by 2070
